many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A solid divider separates two equally sized patterns; keep their overlap.
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if row[0] != 0 and all(v == row[0] for v in row) and r > 0 and h-r-1 == r:
            return [[2 if grid[i][j] != 0 and grid[h-1-i][j] != 0 else 0 for j in range(w)] for i in range(r)]
    for c in range(w):
        if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(grid[i][c] == grid[0][c] for i in range(h)) and c > 0 and w-c-1 == c:
            return [[2 if grid[i][j] != 0 and grid[i][w-1-j] != 0 else 0 for j in range(c)] for i in range(h)]
    raise ValueError("no centered solid divider found")
'''
path=program_dir/'task-321ece15.py'
path.write_text(code)
print(path)
